purpose: Blind labels for 50 new train clips (ids disjoint from the 20 spot-check clips), by 10 Claude Sonnet 5.5 subagents, 5 clips each. Each saw only caption, rubric and video frames (overview + full-rate zooms), no teacher output and no earlier annotation. sa_score / pc_score are computed with teacher/scoring.py from the item statuses.
sampling: Stratified by branch (Mechanics 11, Optics 10, Heat 10, Electricity 10, Acoustics 9) and generator (CogVideoX 17, LTX 17, Wan 16), independent of the teacher scores. One video per rubric.
confidence: One clip_confidence per video for the whole rubric (high / medium / low) with a one-sentence reason; no per-item confidence.

clips.caption: A match is struck against the side of its box, and it flares into a flame that settles to a steady burn.
clips.clip_confidence_reason: The match is barely visible so its state and the flame count are hard to judge.
clips.clip_summary: Close-up of a burning flame at the edge of a cardboard box from 0.0s. No strike or scrape is visible; a thin stick is faintly seen behind the flame at 0-0.3s and a dark charred stub appears left of the flame from about 3.0s. The flame is already large at 0s with a sideways streak, settles to an upright two-lobed flame by 1.0s, then a bright sideways streak flares again at about 2.0-2.7s before it settles again.

uncovered.what: Two flame lobes and a detached-looking sideways streak at the start; match mostly not visible

items.check: A match is struck against its box.
items.evidence: No striking motion is seen; the clip opens with a flame already burning at the box edge.

items.check: The flame flares up.
items.evidence: No initial flare from a small flame is seen; the flame is large from 0s.

items.check: The flame settles to a steady burn.
items.evidence: Flame is unsteady, with a second flare at 2.0-2.7s, and is not clearly tied to a match.

items.check: The strike is against the side of the box.
items.evidence: No strike is shown at all, so none against the side of the box (derived from the S1 evidence after the rubric edit).

items.check: The order is strike, flare, steady burn.
items.evidence: The strike-flare-steady sequence is not shown.

items.expect: The flame appears at the head at the moment it scrapes the box and not before.
items.fail: The flame appears before the head touches the box; or the head scrapes across the box and no flame appears at all; or the flame appears at the stick's far end; or the flame appears with the match held clear of the box.
items.evidence: The head never scrapes the box in view.

items.expect: The flame flares and then settles to a steady burn, and the blackening behind it only spreads.
items.fail: The flame settles and then flares up again with nothing added; or a blackened part of the stick turns back to pale wood; or the flame goes out and relights by itself; or the blackening retreats along the stick.
items.evidence: The flame settled by about 1.0s and then a bright sideways flare reappears at about 2.0-2.7s with nothing added.
items.matched_fail: The flame settles and then flares up again with nothing added

items.expect: The flame points upward whatever way the match is held.
items.fail: The flame points downward; or leans with the match rather than standing upright; or hangs below the head; or points along the stick toward the fingers whatever way is up.
items.evidence: Flame points upward throughout.

items.expect: The matchstick stays a stiff stick that blackens and curls where it has burnt, and the box stays a rigid box.
items.fail: The stick melts and drips; or stays pale and straight where the flame has passed; or the box catches and vanishes at once; or the stick stretches as it burns.
items.evidence: Box stays rigid; a dark stub of stick is visible and no melting or dripping is seen.

items.expect: One match and one box; the match shortens only by burning and the box keeps its shape.
items.fail: A second flame appears on the stick; or the match vanishes while still long; or the flame detaches from the match and floats; or the box changes into another object.
items.evidence: No clearly separate floating flame or changed box; two adjacent lobes read as one turbulent flame.

items.expect: The box's label, the hand and the background stay the same.
items.fail: The box's label changes; or the background changes between frames; or the unburnt part of the stick changes colour.
items.evidence: Box, its printed marks and the background stay consistent.

clips.caption: Sand is sprinkled on a cymbal and a violin bow is drawn along its edge, and the sand jumps and gathers into lines.

A dense cloud of grains is in the air over the whole 5 s, with radial ridges in the sand on the right that are already present at 0s. The sand does not visibly reorganise into new lines.

uncovered.what: Sand pattern and airborne grains already present at 0s with no visible bowing motion

items.evidence: Sand lies heaped on the cymbal from 0s.

items.check: A violin bow is drawn along the cymbal's edge.
items.evidence: The bow stands vertical with its frog on the edge and is not drawn along the edge in any frame.

items.check: The sand jumps.
items.evidence: Many grains are airborne above the cymbal throughout.

items.check: The sand gathers into lines.
items.evidence: Radial ridges are already there at 0s and no new lines form during the clip.

clips.clip_summary: A frosted, already heavily beaded glass beer mug sits under a fixed tap on a sunny terrace. From 0 to about 3s beer and foam fill the mug from the tap; the streak of tap water is visible through the wall. The droplets on the glass are present from the first frame and do not visibly change, and no runs or table wetting appear. At 5s the mug is about three-quarters full.

items.evidence: Droplets do not shrink, vanish or turn to frost during the clip.

items.fail: A droplet runs up the mug; or water gathers on the rim's top and stays; or a drop leaves the mug and rises; or a run travels sideways round the mug and stays level.
items.evidence: No drop grows enough to run, and no run appears in the clip.

items.fail: The table changes pattern; or the tap changes shape; or the drink changes colour.
items.evidence: Table, tap and beer colour stay constant.

clips.caption: A powerful motorcycle revs its engine at a kerb, and the leaves of a potted plant on the pavement beside it quiver.
clips.clip_confidence_reason: A very fine leaf tremble may be too small to see in stills.
clips.clip_summary: A close-up of a motorcycle's rear wheel and exhaust next to a potted yellow-green plant on a paved pavement. The wheel, bike and plant stay nearly still for the whole 5s. Compared frame by frame at 1.0-2.0s the leaves do not visibly move, and no hand, exhaust puff or bike shudder appears.

items.check: A motorcycle stands at a kerb.
items.evidence: A motorcycle's rear wheel and exhaust on the paving.

items.check: A potted plant stands on the pavement beside it.
items.evidence: A potted plant stands on the pavement beside it.

items.check: The plant's leaves quiver.
items.evidence: Leaves look identical across full-rate frames 1.0-2.0s; no quiver seen.

items.check: The motorcycle is revved: a hand on the throttle, an exhaust puff or the bike's own shudder marks it.
items.evidence: No hand on a throttle, exhaust puff or bike shudder seen.

items.check: The motorcycle stays in place; it does not ride off.
items.evidence: The bike stays in place.

items.expect: The leaves tremble on their stems while the pot and the base of the stem stay fixed.
items.fail: The pot slides along the pavement; or the whole plant bends over and stays bent; or leaves float away from the plant; or the leaves keep their exact pose frozen while the pot itself trembles.
items.evidence: Pot is still and no leaf is seen floating or frozen against a trembling pot.

items.expect: The leaves quiver while the bike shudders or puffs exhaust and settle when it calms.
items.fail: The bike shudders for a spell and the leaves stay frozen; or the leaves quiver hard while the bike sits with no shudder and no exhaust puff; or the leaves start before the bike shows any sign of running.
items.evidence: No bike shudder or exhaust puff is visible.

items.expect: Leaves hang from their stems and the pot rests on the ground; anything that comes free falls.
items.fail: A leaf that comes free rises; or the pot lifts; or the plant hangs upward.
items.evidence: Leaves hang from stems and pot rests on the ground.

items.expect: The leaves flex as thin leaves and the stems bend; the pot is rigid.
items.fail: The pot flexes like rubber; or the leaves swing as stiff boards; or the stems stretch.
items.evidence: Leaves look like thin leaves, pot rigid.

items.expect: One bike, one plant; leaves do not multiply.
items.fail: A second plant appears; or the plant vanishes; or the bike passes through the kerb; or leaves multiply in one frame.
items.evidence: One bike, one plant.

items.expect: The bike's colour, the pot's pattern and the leaves' colour stay the same.
items.fail: The bike changes colour; or the pot changes pattern; or the leaves change colour.
items.evidence: Colours stay the same.

items.evidence: Paper outside the dish and its print do not change.

clips.caption: A lit sparkler stands upright in a cake, throwing off a spray of bright sparks that fade as they fall.
clips.clip_confidence_reason: Many round glowing dots are hard to tell from sparks that are fading or falling.
clips.clip_summary: A lit sparkler stands upright in a cake with blue beads on a dark background. Bright branching sparks burst from the burning tip all through the 5s, and round bright dots drift around the whole frame, some falling slowly. A few star-shaped sparks hit the cake rim and vanish at about 1.0, 1.3 and 2.0s, and the tip dims at 4.7s then flares again.

uncovered.what: Many large round glowing dots, some staying in view for over 0.5s, spread across the whole frame

items.check: A lit sparkler stands upright in a cake.
items.evidence: Lit sparkler in a cake throughout.

items.check: Sparks spray out from the sparkler's burning point.
items.evidence: Sparks spray from the glowing tip.

items.check: The sparks fade as they travel.
items.evidence: Sparks shrink and vanish as they travel.

items.check: The sparks are bright.
items.evidence: The sparks are bright.

items.check: The sparks travel away from the sparkler.
items.evidence: Sparks travel outward and down from the sparkler.

items.expect: The sparks fly outward from the burning point and their paths bend downward, going dark before or as they land.
items.fail: The sparks rise steadily and gather above the sparkler; or hang in the air; or lie on the cake glowing like lamps for the rest of the clip; or curve upward after leaving the wire.
items.evidence: Sparks fly out and drift down; none rise and gather.

items.expect: Each spark fades within a short flight and none accumulate, and the sparkler is one wire.
items.fail: Sparks persist as fixed bright dots; or a glowing pile builds on the cake; or sparks appear in the air far from the sparkler; or a second sparkler appears already lit.
items.evidence: Dots move and vanish; no pile builds on the cake.

items.expect: The burning point only travels down the wire and the spent wire above it stays dark.

items.fail: The icing changes colour; or the plate changes pattern; or items on the table rearrange.

clips.caption: A few grains of salt lie on a xylophone bar; the bar is struck with a mallet and the grains jump off.
clips.clip_confidence_reason: Brown blur streaks and the mallet's motion blur make the contact moment hard to read.
clips.clip_summary: A close-up of wooden xylophone bars at an angle with a small white heap of salt sitting in the dark gap beside the bar edge. A mallet head swings in from above at 0.3s, 0.7s, 1.3s and 2.0s, and at 2.3-2.4s it strikes the bar right next to the salt. The salt stays as the same heap through the end, and brown blurry streaks sweep across the bars.

uncovered.what: Brown blurred streaks sweep across the bars like extra mallet shadows
